method: Prior-only date-block walk-forward; exact point-model scoring simulator versus hierarchically shrunk, five-year-decayed empirical total-games distributions.

format_rules.standard_tiebreak_7: Best-of-three, 7-point tiebreak at 6-6 in all sets.
format_rules.grand_slam_final_tiebreak_10: For 2022 onward Grand Slam BO3 rows, 7-point tiebreaks before the deciding set and 10-point deciding-set tiebreak at 6-6.
format_rules.match_tiebreak_10: Bracketed deciding match tiebreak; it adds no games to the total-games target.

evidence_status: Development backtest. The 2023-2026 winner sample has been inspected; this is a different target, but total-games outcomes must not be called untouched confirmation.
